```{r include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(caret)
library(readxl)
library(ggfortify)
library(GGally)
library(glmnet)
library(Hmisc)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r read_data}
db <- read_excel(here("data/dataform.xlsx"))
db <- na.omit(db)

db$ID <- as.factor(db$ID) 
db$Group <- as.factor(db$Group) 

#Removing redundant variables:

colnames(db)

db <- db %>%
  select(-c("MitoCount", "TotArea", "Bcount", "TotPerim", "TotBLength", "Bjunct", "BEndP"))

```



# Visualization

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
long_db <- db %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, Group), names_to = "Predictor", values_to = "Value")

long_db %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#a39b9b", "#67c7c5", "#f2de79")) +
  theme_classic()

long_db %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#a39b9b", "#67c7c5", "#f2de79")) +
  theme_classic()


```


# PCA

```{r}

red_vars <- redun(as.matrix(db[-c(1,2)]))

db_res <- db %>%
  select(c("ID", "Group", red_vars$In))

db_res %>%
  select(-c(ID, Group)) %>%
  ggpairs() 

  

```




```{r}
set.seed(2024)

db_ml <- db_res 


trnIndex <- createDataPartition(db_ml$Group, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

trn <- db_ml[trnIndex,]
tst <- db_ml[-trnIndex,]

trn[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(trn[-c(1,2)]))
tst[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(tst[-c(1,2)]))


```




```{r}

set.seed(2024)

train_control <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats=3)

train_model <- function(dat, method, search_grid=NULL) {
  set.seed(2024)
  
  mdl <- train(Group ~ .,
               data = dat[-1], 
               method = method,
               tuneGrid = search_grid,
               trControl = train_control,
               trace = FALSE)
  
  return(mdl)
}

make_bound_plot <- function(mod, dat, pcx = 1, pcy = 2, alg) {
  set.seed(2024)  # Ensure reproducibility in PCA transformation

  preproc <- preProcess(dat[-c(1,2)], method = c("pca"))
  pca_transformed <- predict(preproc, dat[-c(1,2)])
  pca_transformed <- data.frame(pca_transformed, Group = dat$Group)

  colnames(pca_transformed)[pcx] <- "X"
  colnames(pca_transformed)[pcy] <- "Y"

  # Create a grid of points in the PCA-transformed space
  x_min <- min(pca_transformed$X) - 1
  x_max <- max(pca_transformed$X) + 1
  y_min <- min(pca_transformed$Y) - 1
  y_max <- max(pca_transformed$Y) + 1

  # Generate grid points
  grid <- expand.grid(X = seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 100),
                      Y = seq(y_min, y_max, length.out = 100))

  # Combine the grid with zeros for other components
  grid_full <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = nrow(grid), ncol = ncol(pca_transformed)-1))
  colnames(grid_full) <- colnames(pca_transformed)[-ncol(pca_transformed)]
  grid_full[, c(pcx, pcy)] <- grid

  # Inverse transform the grid to the original feature space
  inverse_pca <- function(pca_model, pca_data) {
    center <- pca_model$mean
    scale <- pca_model$std
    rotation <- pca_model$rotation
    
    # Calculate the original data matrix
    original_matrix <- as.matrix(pca_data) %*% t(rotation)
    
    # Re-scale and re-center
    original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, scale, `*`)
    original_matrix <- sweep(original_matrix, 2, center, `+`)
    
    return(as.data.frame(original_matrix))
  }

  # Perform inverse PCA transformation on the grid
  grid_original <- inverse_pca(preproc, grid_full)
  colnames(grid_original) <- colnames(dat[-c(1,2)])

  # Predict on the original feature space
  grid_original$Group <- predict(mod, grid_original, type = "raw")

  # Plot the decision boundary
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = pca_transformed, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = Group), size = 2) +
    geom_tile(data = grid, aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = grid_original$Group), alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste(alg, "Decision Boundary with PCA"),
         x = paste("Principal Component", pcx),
         y = paste("Principal Component", pcy)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Reference", labels = levels(pca_transformed$Group), values = c("#a39b9b",  "#67c7c5", "#f2de79")) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Prediction", labels = levels(pca_transformed$Group), values = c("#a39b9b",  "#67c7c5", "#f2de79"))
}


```


Multinomial logistic regression with neural networks {.tabset}
=====================================================================



```{r, message=FALSE}

set.seed(2024)

search_grid <- expand.grid(
  decay = seq(0, 0.2, by = 0.01)
)

multi_model <- train_model(trn, "multinom", search_grid)

pred_multi_model <- data.frame(Prediction = predict(multi_model, newx = as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type="raw"))

trn_class_res <- data.frame(ID = trn$ID, Prediction = pred_multi_model, Reference = trn$Group)

cfm <- confusionMatrix(predict(multi_model), trn$Group, positive = "DNML1")



```

Column 
---------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
make_bound_plot(multi_model, trn, 1, 2, "Neural Network")
```


```{r}
make_bound_plot(multi_model, trn, 1, 3, "Neural Network") 
```

Column {data-width="350"}
---------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
make_bound_plot(multi_model, trn, 2, 3, "Neural Network")
```

### Accuracy

```{r}
knitr::kable(cfm$table)
```

### Variable Importance

```{r}
knitr::kable(varImp(multi_model)[1])
```



# Random Forest

```{r}
set.seed(2024)


search_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry = seq(1, 4, by = 1)
)

rf_model <- train_model(trn, "rf", search_grid)

cfm_2 <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model), trn$Group, positive = "DNML1")


```

# SVM

```{r}
set.seed(2024)



# Preprocess with PCA and train SVM model
svm_model <- train_model(trn, "svmLinear")



pred_svm <- predict(svm_model, as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type = "raw")

confusionMatrix(pred_svm, trn$Group, positive = "DNM1L")

make_bound_plot(svm_model, trn, 1,2, "SVM")
make_bound_plot(svm_model, trn, 1,3, "SVM")
make_bound_plot(svm_model, trn, 2,3, "SVM")

```


# Final model




```{r}
set.seed(2024)

model_list <- list(Neural = multi_model, SVM = svm_model, RF = rf_model)

res <- resamples(model_list)

summary(res)


pred_tst <- predict(multi_model, tst[-c(1,2)], type = "raw")

confusionMatrix(pred_tst, tst$Group, positive = "DNM1L")

make_bound_plot(multi_model, tst,1,2, "Neural Network")
make_bound_plot(multi_model, tst, 1,3, "Neural Network")
make_bound_plot(multi_model, tst ,2,3, "Neural Network")

```
